## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and the behavior after this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Run the complete unit test suite.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a meaningful test.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private program text, target evidence, or generated data files are included.

## Security boundaries

- [ ] Scope and authorization still fail closed.
- [ ] The MCP gains no generic shell, scanner, credential, or report-submission capability.
- [ ] Imported or fetched content remains untrusted data.
- [ ] Any new external dependency or integration includes its license and provenance.
